from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler import json,sqlite3 DB=sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.db') DB.execute('create table if not exists counter (n integer)') if not DB.execute('select n from counter').fetchone(): DB.execute('insert into counter values (0)'); DB.commit() class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler): def do_GET(self): n=DB.execute('select n from counter').fetchone()[0] data=('

Counter

Count: '+str(n)+'

').encode() self.send_response(200);self.send_header('Content-Type','text/html');self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(data) def do_POST(self): DB.execute('update counter set n=n+1');DB.commit();data=json.dumps({'n':DB.execute('select n from counter').fetchone()[0]}).encode() self.send_response(200);self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json');self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(data) HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0',3000),Handler).serve_forever()
